steps.title: Weigh soil sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.5 g of soil, removing debris such as stones or large particles.

steps.title: Transfer soil to tube
steps.instruction: Add the weighed soil into a PowerBead Pro Tube.

steps.title: Add Solution CD1
steps.instruction: Add Solution CD1 to the tube according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Homogenize for cell lysis
steps.instruction: Homogenize the mixture using the Vortex Adapter method, ensuring proper mixing and cell lysis.

steps.title: Add Solution CD2
steps.instruction: Add Solution CD2 to the tube to remove impurities.

steps.title: Add CD3 and load column
steps.instruction: Add Solution CD3 and then load the sample into the MB Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Add Solution CD3 to the tube.
Load the mixture onto the MB Spin Column.

steps.title: Wash spin column
steps.instruction: Wash the column sequentially with Solution EA followed by Solution C5 to ensure purity.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column using Solution C6 and collect the eluate.

steps.title: Check DNA quality by gel
steps.instruction: Perform electrophoresis on an agarose gel to confirm DNA quality.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Use a Nanodrop spectrophotometer to measure DNA concentration and purity.

steps.title: Send e‑DNA for analysis
steps.instruction: Send the extracted e‑DNA to the FAILSAFE Project Team at Chulalongkorn University for further analysis.
